_note: Work that stays with people (inventory automation_pattern none-keep-human). core/levers/registry.py refuses any lever whose name matches a pattern (fnmatch, lowercase, * matches any characters). Read-only fact packs use other names (B-37, B-48). Changing this file needs a DECISIONS entry. Synthetic prototype.

entries.name: Urgent or hostile termination
entries.reason: The decision and the timing are human; people may press pre-built levers (W-ONB-08, W-EP-08) with approval.

entries.name: Caller identity verification
entries.reason: A model never judges whether a caller is who they claim; tooling may only show the callback number on file and record that a person verified.

entries.name: Conditional Access policy change
entries.reason: Needs a change record, report-only testing and engineer sign-off; drift detection stays read-only.

entries.name: Privileged role grants and PIM activation approval
entries.reason: Admin grants define who controls a client tenant; agents may only report who holds what.

entries.name: Sensitivity labels and DLP policy changes
entries.reason: Policy changes are human with change approval; agents may report state and simulation results.

entries.name: Retention, litigation hold and eDiscovery requests
entries.reason: Legal authority, scope and content handling are human; content is never placed in a prompt.

entries.name: Disk encryption status and recovery key retrieval
entries.reason: Key retrieval is human after identity verification; key values never reach a model, a ticket body or a log.

entries.name: Local admin password (LAPS) retrieval and admin-rights requests
entries.reason: Retrieval is human; password values never reach a model or a log. Agents may report LAPS coverage only.

entries.name: Network device firmware (firewalls, switches, access points)
entries.reason: Upgrades are human; agents may report versions against advisories.

entries.name: Ransomware or disaster recovery decision
entries.reason: The people in charge decide; agents may only fetch read-only status for them.

entries.name: Security incident declaration and breach notification decision
entries.reason: Breach determination and notification are legal decisions owned by the client with counsel; agents may assemble a factual timeline from the audit log.

entries.name: Firewall and SASE rule changes
entries.reason: A human change with a change record; agents may diff current rules against documentation, read-only.

entries.name: Policy attestations and management assertions
entries.reason: A signature is a person's accountable statement.

entries.name: License purchase or reduction
entries.reason: Spending is human: agents may recommend, the client approves and a human orders.

entries.name: Domain and DNS registrar changes
entries.reason: Human only with a change record; agents may validate a proposed record set, read-only.

entries.name: Credential vault entries in the documentation platform
entries.reason: No AI access to vault contents; they are excluded from retrieval, prompts and logs.

entries.name: Contract terms, pricing and billing disputes
entries.reason: Commercial relationships are human; agents may fetch facts.

entries.name: Client offboarding from the MSP
entries.reason: Human-run; agents may produce the checklist and the read-only proof that MSP access is gone.

entries.name: Secrets and managed identity management
entries.reason: Humans create and rotate secrets; code only references them; agents never read secret values.

entries.name: Model and tool approval
entries.reason: Approving a provider or tool is a human decision recorded in DECISIONS.

entries.name: AI incident response
entries.reason: Humans lead; agents can be switched off by one config change and supply the audit timeline.

entries.name: New technician onboarding and performance coaching
entries.reason: Judgments about people are never automated; AI output and metrics are never the basis for ratings or discipline.
